tasks.label: configure acg debug
args: source /opt/intel/oneapi/setvars.sh --force >/dev/null && export PATH="/opt/dpcpp/llvm/build/bin:$PATH" && export LD_LIBRARY_PATH="/opt/dpcpp/llvm/build/lib:${LD_LIBRARY_PATH:-}" && cmake -S . -B build -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug -DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER=/opt/dpcpp/llvm/build/bin/clang++

tasks.label: build acg debug
args: source /opt/intel/oneapi/setvars.sh --force >/dev/null && export PATH="/opt/dpcpp/llvm/build/bin:$PATH" && export LD_LIBRARY_PATH="/opt/dpcpp/llvm/build/lib:${LD_LIBRARY_PATH:-}" && cmake -S . -B build -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug -DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER=/opt/dpcpp/llvm/build/bin/clang++ && cmake --build build
